case_title.quote: POLAMURI CHANDRA SEKHARARAO @ CHINNA@ BABJI .V. STATE OF A.P.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant was prosecuted for committing the murder

accused_gender.quote: the accused, enraged by the statement of the deceased, brought a long knife
accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to as a man (appellant, father of two daughters).

accused_occupation.quote: The accused not attending to his duty on 06.04.2004
accused_occupation.reason: The judgment never states the accused's occupation.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased is none other than the nephew of the appellant i.e. son of his elder sister
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Nephew relationship and friction with the victim's mother are supported.

offence_category.quote: offence punishable under Section 302, Indian Penal Code

statutory_provisions.quote: offence punishable under Section 302, Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: brought a long knife from his bed room

evidence_type.quote: The FSL report also confirmed that human blood was found on the weapon
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial, medical, recovery and forensic evidence are all reflected.

confession.quote: handed over the knife to the Station writer stating that he had killed the deceased
confession.reason: The prosecution alleged an oral statement; the Court did not rely on it as a confession.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: there were as many as 17 injuries ... 13 injuries were incised cut injuries
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Supported by the injury findings and the unexplained body.

trial_court_outcome.quote: imposing the sentence of imprisonment for life and a fine of Rs. 1,000/- with default sentence of simple imprisonment for a period of three months
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction under s.302 with life imprisonment and fine.

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court declined to interfere with the conviction and sentence

final_outcome.quote: The appeal, therefore, fails and the same is dismissed.

imprisonment_years.reason: Not a fixed term; null is right.

neutral_facts.reason: Accurate summary of the incident and evidence; no names, outcome or court proceedings.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.quote: 17 injuries noted in the post-mortem certificate ... 13 injuries were incised cut injuries

premeditation_planning.quote: enraged by the statement of the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Provoked by anger; no planning found.

motive.quote: it was the appellant who got enraged by the conduct of the deceased in his attempt to develop close relationship with his daughter

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The FSL report also confirmed that human blood was found on the weapon
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the evidence the Court relied on.

witness_credibility.quote: Merely because PWs-3,4,6 and 7 are related to the deceased., there is no reason why they should implicate the appellant

post_offence_conduct.quote: went to the Steel Plant Police Station ... handed over the knife
post_offence_conduct.reason: As alleged by the prosecution; no explanation for the body.

trial_duration.reason: Dates correct; trial judgment date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Chanchal Kumar Ganguli for the Appellant. Amit K. Nain, D. Mahesh Babu, Mayur R. Shah, Savita Devi for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: As many as 15 witnesses were examined

appeal_history.quote: The High Court declined to interfere

prosecution_argument.quote: though PW-1 supported Exhibit P-1 in her Examination-in-Chief, she had to be treated as hostile

defence_argument.quote: Exhibit P-1, alleged to have been given by PW-1 cannot be acted upon

legal_principle_applied.quote: it was for him to explain as to how the dead body was found in his house

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: None (Court only noted the deceased was 'mercilessly wounded'; no sentencing factors weighed)
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: the deceased was mercilessly wounded with the knife (M.0.-10)
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court weighed no sentencing aggravating factors; the listed items are guilt-related findings.
